source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Check SUT will take correct activity as PCIE uncorrectable fatal error via AMD RAS Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. NBIO Common options → ACS Enable: Enable b. NBIO Common options → Enable AER Cap: Enable c. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Root Port UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 d. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Device UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 e. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enable f. NBIO Common Options → NBIO RAS Common Options → SyncFlood on PCIe Fatal Error: True 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Execute the following command to get a list of devices in the PCIe slots: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listpcieslotsbdfinfo 6. PCIe Correctable Error inject to end device, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjbiopcie --segment 0 --bus 65 --device 0 --function 0 --errortype 2 7. PCIe Correctable Error inject to root port, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjbiopcie --segment 0 --bus 64 --device 1 --function 1 --errortype 2 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For Uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report. Noted: EINJ-based uncorrectable fatal error injection is completed by triggering PCIe ECRC error at root port or end device
